blocks.text: NEW YORK, United States—Faculty members at Cornell University on Friday passed a no-confidence resolution against the elite college’s leadership over its handling of an alleged gang rape that has sparked outcry in the United States. The vote is not binding but marks a strong symbolic rebuke of administrators at Ivy League college in New York state. According to a lawsuit, a female student was assaulted by seven male students at a fraternity house on campus. Following her initial allegations in 2024, Cornell shut down the fraternity — a male social club — and temporarily suspended the accused students, two of whom were later expelled. […]...
